feeds.title: ChatterBug Blog
feeds.description: ChatterBug Blog provides further information on all things Speech and Language! From information about our team and services to new studies and articles. ChatterBug is a social enterprise dedicated to helping children develop their communication skills. We continuously seek ways in which we can make a difference to the lives of those with Speech, Language, and Communication Needs (SLCN).

feeds.title: The London Speech and Feeding Practice Blog
feeds.description: Stay up to date with our latest news! Browse here to find answers to common questions and interesting topics. I'm Sonja McGeachie. I'm an Independent Speech and Language Therapist based in London with over 25 years of experience helping babies and children with developmental delays and complex needs overcome speech, language, and feeding challenges.

feeds.title: WordSteps Edinburgh Speech Therapy Blog
feeds.description: Welcome to Wordsteps, my name is Anna Biavati-Smith and I am a private Specialist Speech and Language Therapist based in Edinburgh. My service supports children and young adults find their voice through helpful steps in communication.

feeds.title: SaLT by the Sea Blog
feeds.description: An independent Speech and Language Therapy service providing face-to-face therapy and online support for families of young children with speech, language and communication needs. Our mission is to improve children's communication skills and enable parents to feel confident in helping their child.

feeds.title: ChildSpeech
feeds.description: ChildSpeech has a team of experienced speech and language therapists with a broad range of specialisms to ensure your child receives the most appropriate support. Specialisms include stammering, autism, ADOS assessment, developmental language disorder (DLD), selective mutism and speech sound disorders. Explore the latest news and updates on our services, speech therapy tips and more!

feeds.title: Speech Therapists' Links Blog
feeds.description: Speech Therapists' Links is a global community built for fledging and experienced speech therapists (STs). We aim to provide advice, support and a safe environment to grow and become the best clinicians we can be. The blog features articles on speech difficulty, therapy, advice and more!

feeds.title: C&D Speech Therapy Blog
feeds.description: Discover updates, hints, tips and thoughts from the C&D Speech & Language Therapy team. C&D Independent Speech & Language Therapy is a high-quality private service supporting children and young people to communicate. Our team of qualified and registered Speech & Language therapists see children in our clinic, at home, school or nursery to assess and treat a range of speech, language and communication difficulties.
